method.viewport: Chrome DevTools Protocol Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride at 320/390/640/768/1024/1280/1536/1920, fresh navigation per route; the in-app browser surface is 882px wide so >=1024 was read through element geometry (getBoundingClientRect + getComputedStyle), and pixel captures used Page.captureScreenshot with an explicit clip
probes: horizontal overflow: any non-fixed element whose border box leaves the viewport (right > innerWidth + 1.5 or left < -1.5)
vertical clipping: any element with overflow-y hidden|clip and scrollHeight > clientHeight + 3, excluding line-clamp-* which clamps on purpose
content cut: any element with overflow-x hidden|clip that is neither clamped nor nowrap and whose scrollWidth exceeds clientWidth by more than 4px
dead space: card bottom (minus bottom padding and border) minus the lowest visible descendant, i.e. panel the reader sees as empty
target size: computed height and width of every button, link, summary, select and role=button
